title: Rogue Wax Works Dynavap Cooling Unit
description:
Rogue Wax Works Dynavap Cooling Unit
A more than handy accessory for any dynavap lover. Here you will find a variety of stainless steel cooling units from Rogue Wax Works. Any of the cooling units on this page can be used on any genuine dynavap condenser tube. Although if using with an omni you are better off going with the omni versions as they have a tapered end ensuring the tip does not get caught up as you adjust the condenser tube forward.
Included
1 X Rogue Wax Works Dynavap Cooling Unit (Choose Type)
